english.title: VAT - acquired goods / services on which VAT evaded
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[acquired possession of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),]_
(B)_[dealt with goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..),]_
(C)_[accepted the supply of services, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SERVICES..),]_

having reason to believe that the Value Added Tax

(D)_[on the supply of]_
(E)_[on the importation of]_

(F)_[those goods]_
(G)_[those services]_

(H)_[had been]_
(I)_[would be]_

evaded
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72(10) of the Value Added Tax Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
acquired possession/dealt with any goods OR
accepted the supply of any service
having had reason to believe that the Value Added Tax on the supply of
those goods/that service
had been/would be evaded

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H3694 (CJS code VA94005).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding £20,000 or a penalty equal to three times the amount of VAT whichever is the greater.
